gcloud alpha services api-keys create against project einhorn-mjolnir, restricted to generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Real follow-up flagged: move into IDUNA Vault via emily vault unlock/add once convenient. K8s Secret storage (S207-06) deliberately deferred, no live cluster exists yet.
